lines.en: label karinspring4:
scene sky
Unable to sit around and wait any longer, I decide to head over to the dojo in hopes of seeing Osako and curing her chronic hopelessness with something other than my penis.
lines.zh: 再也坐不住了，我决定去一趟道场，希望能见到 Osako，用我阴茎之外的东西治一治她那慢性绝望。

lines.en: I mean, I {i}would{/i} attempt to cure it with my penis if she wanted me to. But I highly doubt my penis has anything to do with the reason her relationship is currently in shambles to begin with.
lines.zh: 我是说，如果她想，我{i}倒也{/i}不介意用阴茎来治。但我非常怀疑，她那段感情如今一团糟，跟我那玩意儿有什么关系。

lines.en: So yeah, maybe I’ll try that “talking” thing I have to do with some of the other girls sometimes. And maybe this time, Osako won’t blindside me by revealing she knows about any past traumas.
lines.zh: 所以好吧，也许我可以试试那种我偶尔得跟别的女孩做的「谈话」。也许这一次 Osako 不会突然甩出一句「我知道你过去的创伤」来打我个措手不及。

lines.en: Either way, I’m on my way to the dojo to renew some confidence and hopefully discover some new information that won’t make me feel terrible or anxious anymore.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我正往道场去，想找回点自信，也希望能挖到些新消息，不至于再让我难受或焦虑。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo1
Never mind. I feel terrible again.
lines.zh: 当我没说。我又难受起来了。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Karin! Face forward! Looking away from your opponent in the middle of a fight is no different from just {i}asking{/i} for defeat.
lines.zh: : Karin！看前面！在交手中把视线从对手身上移开，跟主动{i}求败{/i}没有区别。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo2
: Oh, sorry! I just...know him. And I...wasn’t really expecting to see him here.
lines.zh: : 啊，抱歉！我只是……认识他。而且我……没想到会在这儿见到他。

lines.en: : I know him too, but you don’t see {i}me{/i} breaking focus and giving my opponent the window of opportunity they’ve been waiting for.
lines.zh: : 我也认识他，但你没看见{i}我{/i}把注意力分散掉，把对手一直等的机会窗口拱手让人吧。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo3
: So he...comes here often then?
lines.zh: : 那他……经常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : And now you’re looking away! You need to be aware of your surroundings at all times, Karin!
lines.zh: : 现在你又把视线移开了！你必须时刻留意周围的情况，Karin！

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo4
: B-b-b-b-but you just told me I shouldn’t look at my surroundings!
lines.zh: : 可-可-可-可-是你刚刚才说我不该看周围！

lines.en: : What I meant is that you shouldn’t {i}focus{/i} on them. Always know what’s happening around you, but keep your eye on the prize. And the prize isn’t on the ground!
lines.zh: : 我的意思是你不该把注意力{i}集中{/i}在上面。要始终知道身边在发生什么，但眼睛要盯着目标。而且目标不在地上！

lines.en: : Oh, uhh...right! Sorry! Again!
lines.zh: : 啊，呃……对！对不起！又来了！

lines.en: : Should I come back a different time? If Karin’s here, I probably shouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 我要不要换个时间来？既然 Karin 在，我大概不该——

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo5
: Actually, no. For once in my life, I’m actually glad you’re here. Get on the mat and take my place as Karin’s sparring partner.
lines.zh: : 不，恰恰相反。我这辈子难得有一次真高兴你在这儿。上垫子去，替我当 Karin 的陪练。

lines.en: : What happened to your hair?
lines.zh: : 你头发怎么回事？

lines.en: : A stylist. You should see one next. Does that really matter right now?
lines.zh: : 找了发型师。你下一个也该去。现在说这个真的要紧吗？

lines.en: : Uh...I...don’t know if it’s a...good idea for Sensei to...
lines.zh: : 呃……我……不知道让 Sensei 来……是不是个好主意……

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo6
: It’s fine. He might {i}look{/i} useless...and he might normally {i}be{/i} useless...but the reason you’re here in the first place is because you want to learn self-defense, right?
lines.zh: : 没事。他{i}看起来{/i}可能很没用……平时也{i}确实{/i}很没用……但你来这儿的初衷是想学防身术，对吧？

lines.en: : Statistically speaking, you’re less likely to be robbed or attacked by someone if you’re bigger than them. So having an opponent his size will be a lot closer to how it would be in real life.
lines.zh: : 从统计上说，如果你比对方高大，被抢或被袭的概率就更低。所以找一个他这种体型的对手，会更接近真实情况。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo7
: You don’t say...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: : Akira, come on.
lines.zh: : Akira，别磨蹭了。

lines.en: : Osako-
lines.zh: : Osako——

lines.en: : We can {i}talk{/i} later, okay? This is a trial course, and I’m not going to be able to let her {i}try{/i} anything if she’s going to be looking at you the whole time.
lines.zh: : 我们晚点再{i}谈{/i}，好吗？这是一堂体验课，她要是全程都盯着你看，我就没法让她{i}练{/i}任何东西了。

lines.en: scene black
: Plus, I’ve got another class coming in one hour and other students to help. So for the first time in your life, could you actually give me a hand here?
lines.zh: : 再说，一小时后还有一班课，还有别的学生要我带。所以这辈子头一回，你能不能真的帮我一把？

lines.en: : I just don’t think Karin wants to-
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得 Karin 不想——

lines.en: : It’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo8
: Like Osaka-sensei says, this is closer to how it would be in real life...
lines.zh: : 就像 Osaka 老师说的，这样更接近真实情况……

lines.en: Somehow, I find myself face to face with Karin in a way...significantly different from how I imagined our next meeting would be.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我和 Karin 就这样面对面了——这跟我设想的下次见面方式差得可不是一点半点。

lines.en: I guess it’s fitting that she’s ready to fight me, though. At least that much tracks.
lines.zh: 不过她摆好架势准备跟我打，倒也挺合适的。至少这一点说得通。

lines.en: But it’s not like I’m actually going to fight {i}back.{/i} I’ll just let her wail on me for a few minutes and deal with whatever sort of disciplinary action Osako has in store later.
lines.zh: 但我也不会真的{i}还手{/i}。我就让她揍我几分钟，然后再去承受 Osako 备好的任何处罚。

lines.en: : Okay. Let’s do this, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就开始吧，我想。

lines.en: : Do what? This is my first lesson and I haven’t learned any...offensive techniques yet.
lines.zh: : 开始什么？这是我的第一堂课，我还没学过任何……进攻招式呢。

lines.en: : To be fair, neither have I and I’ve been coming here for years.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我也没学过，而我都来了好几年了。

lines.en: : {i}To be fair,{/i} you haven’t paid any attention in years!
lines.zh: : {i}说句公道话{/i}，你这些年根本就没认真听过！

lines.en: : That is also true.
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的。

lines.en: : Aren’t you going to put your arms up to defend yourself? Or do you think you can just walk all over me again without any consequences?
lines.zh: : 你不把手抬起来防守吗？还是说你以为可以再把我踩在脚底下而不付出任何代价？

lines.en: : Come at me and find out.
lines.zh: : 你上前来试试就知道了。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo9
: Why?...Is this some kind of trick? What do you have up your sleeve?
lines.zh: : 为什么？……这是什么陷阱吗？你藏着什么招？

lines.en: : Nothing. I just know you don’t want to do this and, respectfully, neither do I.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我只是知道你不想这么做，而且恕我直言，我也不想。

lines.en: : {i}Respectfully,{/i} Akira, I wish you’d employ literally {i}any{/i} of what I’ve taught you the past few years and show Karin that this isn’t some freestyle dojo without rules or regulations.
lines.zh: : {i}恕我直言{/i}，Akira，我真希望你能用上我这几年教你的{i}任何一点{/i}东西，让 Karin 看看这里不是什么没有规矩的自由搏击场。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her. I’ve fought greater battles in this building than she ever will.
lines.zh: : 别听她的。我在这栋楼里打过的硬仗，比她这辈子能打的都多。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Just hit me. You’re here {i}because{/i} of me, aren’t you? So you should have no problem attacking.
lines.zh: : 直接打我就行。你来这儿是{i}因为{/i}我，不是吗？那你动手应该没问题吧。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo10
: Why...do you even come here in the first place? You’ve always been so against...physical activity and stuff.
lines.zh: : 那你……到底为什么来这儿？你一向那么反对……体力活动什么的。

lines.en: : For Ayane, mostly. I’m not interested in fighting.
lines.zh: : 主要是为了 Ayane。我对打架没兴趣。

lines.en: : Well...maybe you should be. Because not everyone’s like me. And one day, someone’s going to fight back. Then that...stupid facade of yours is going to crumble to the ground.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许你该有点兴趣。因为不是每个人都像我。总有一天，会有人反击的。到那时，你那副……愚蠢的伪装就会碎在地上。

lines.en: : You say that like I make a habit of luring girls into the dark.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得，好像我有把女孩骗进暗处的习惯似的。

lines.en: : And for all I know, you do. So...put your arms up or...things are going to get really messy.
lines.zh: : 就我所知，你确实有。所以……把手抬起来，不然……场面会很难看。

lines.en: : No thanks. I’ll just keep them down and let you use me as a punching bag for now. I deserve it.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我就这么垂着手，让你拿我当沙袋吧。我活该。

lines.en: : Who said anything about punching?
lines.zh: : 谁说要打拳了？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo11
scene black
The world goes dark...but I see no light at the end of the tunnel.
lines.zh: 世界黑了下来……可我在隧道尽头看不到光。

lines.en: It’s just an endless tube of blackness and a life of never-ending pain.
lines.zh: 只有一条无尽的黑色管道，和无休止疼痛的一生。

lines.en: How fitting that I’d be destroyed by purity incarnate. And even more so that the tool I’ve used to paint the world red has been ripped from its holster and dropped into the trash.
lines.zh: 我竟被纯洁的化身摧毁，多么贴切。而更贴切的是，我那支用来把世界涂红的笔，被人从枪套里扯下来扔进了垃圾桶。

lines.en: : That’s not a sanctioned move in competitions, but...you know, in terms of self-defense, I’ve got to admit there’s not much out there more effective than that.
lines.zh: : 这在比赛里可不是合规动作，不过……你知道，就防身而言，我得承认没几招比这更管用了。

lines.en: : Thanks. My mom taught me to do that if anyone ever tries to grab me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我妈教我的，说要是有人想抓我就这么干。

lines.en: O world-
lines.zh: 哦，世界啊——

lines.en: Why did I have to be born with testicles?
lines.zh: 为什么我生下来就带着两颗睾丸？

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo12
I manage to pull myself off of the mat several minutes later and find that Karin, for some reason, hasn’t run away from this place yet.
lines.zh: 几分钟后我总算从垫子上爬了起来，发现 Karin 不知为什么还没从这儿跑掉。

lines.en: But instead of blaming this on stupidity, I’ll just go ahead and assume she’s yet to make it to the part of her training that advises fleeing from trouble is just as valid as fighting back against it.
lines.zh: 不过我不想把这归咎于她傻，我就当她还没学到训练里的那一课——遇到麻烦转身就跑，和正面还手一样正当。

lines.en: So valid, in fact, that I’ve made it my life’s duty to do just that. I just happen to also be an expert at neglecting my duty, so I typically wander off to {i}start{/i} trouble elsewhere.
lines.zh: 事实上正当到我把「转身就跑」当成了自己的人生信条。只是我碰巧也是个疏忽职责的专家，所以我通常会溜到别处去{i}惹是生非{/i}。

lines.en: In fact, that’s probably what I’m doing right now as I crawl several feet across the mat and take a seat beside her.
lines.zh: 事实上，此刻我在垫子上爬了几英尺、在她身边坐下，大概就是在干这种事。

lines.en: There are a few other girls in the dojo — ones I haven’t seen before — so I guess it’s safe to assume I’ve stumbled into a full-on beginner’s course since Karin is here too.
lines.zh: 道场里还有几个我没见过的女孩，所以既然 Karin 也在，我大概可以断定自己撞上了一堂彻头彻尾的入门课。

lines.en: But while Osako spends her time {i}actually{/i} instructing people, I’m left to trample on one more flower that grew in the wrong place.
lines.zh: 但 Osako 忙着{i}认真{/i}教课，而我则留在这里，又去践踏一朵长错了地方的花。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see your legs are still a force to be reckoned with despite the lack of a soccer club now.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你的腿脚依然不容小觑，尽管现在没有足球社了。

lines.en: : I’m not sorry.
lines.zh: : 我不后悔。

lines.en: : I’m not saying you should be. I deserved that.
lines.zh: : 我没说你该后悔。那是我活该。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m a little bit sorry.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我有一点点后悔。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo13
: But you kind of deserved it for both...what you did before and...how you surprised me here today.
lines.zh: : 不过你也确实活该，既是因为……你之前做的事，也是因为……今天你在这儿吓了我一跳。

lines.en: : It’s not like I knew you were going to be here. I just wanted to talk to Osako about something.
lines.zh: : 我又不知道你会在这儿。我只是想跟 Osako 谈点事。

lines.en: : Well...this is the only dojo my parents can afford, so...I’ll need to know what days you plan on coming so I can make sure I come at different times.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这是我父母唯一负担得起的道场，所以……我得知道你打算哪天来，好保证我跟你的时间错开。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo14
: You’re serious about this whole self-defense thing then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那你对学防身术这事是认真的咯？

lines.en: : I want to be able to do something if that ever happens again. Just lying there and...letting it happen made me feel terrible about myself.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果再发生那种事，我能做点什么。只是躺在那儿……任由它发生，让我对自己厌恶透了。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : I’ll stop coming here altogether then.
lines.zh: : 那我就不来这儿了。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo15
: What? But you’ve-
lines.zh: : 什么？可你都——

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo16
: You’ve been...coming here for years, right? And this is only my first lesson.
lines.zh: : 你……都来了好几年了吧？而这只是我的第一堂课。

lines.en: : Yeah. But you need it more than I do, and I really just come to talk anyway. Besides, Ayane would make a way better sparring partner than me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但你比我更需要它，而我本来也只是来聊天的。再说，Ayane 当陪练比我强多了。

lines.en: : That’s true. But I don’t know if my special move would work on her the way it worked on you just now.
lines.zh: : 这倒是。不过我不知道我的绝招对她管不管用，就像刚才对你那样。

lines.en: : Probably not, but she’s still got plenty of weaknesses. Whether or not she can be taken {i}down{/i} by them remains to be seen, though. She’s...resilient, if nothing else.
lines.zh: : 大概不管用，不过她的弱点也多的是。只是能不能靠那些弱点把她{i}放倒{/i}，还得走着瞧。她……别的不说，韧性是有的。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo17
: Yeah...
: I hope I can be like that one day.
lines.zh: : 我希望有一天我也能变成那样。

lines.en: : Nothing...{i}bad{/i} has ever really happened to me before. That thing with you was the first time I’ve ever felt so...{i}scared.{/i}
lines.zh: : 以前从来没发生过什么……{i}坏事{/i}。跟你那次，是我第一次感到那么……{i}害怕{/i}。

lines.en: : But it made me think of, like...just how little I’ve experienced so far. And how terrifying and...bad this place can be sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但它让我想到，比如……我到目前为止的经历有多么少。还有这个地方有时候有多可怕、多……糟糕。

lines.en: : And I’ve still got a job to do. Even if Kirin doesn’t like me, she’s my little sister. And if I can’t even protect myself, how am I ever supposed to protect her?
lines.zh: : 而且我还有该做的事。就算 Kirin 不喜欢我，她也是我妹妹。如果我连自己都保护不了，还怎么保护她？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I hope I can get the hang of karate. I’m just not really sure if I’m cut out for it if I’m going to...get distracted as easily as I did before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我希望能摸到空手道的门道。只是我不太确定自己适不适合——如果我还会像刚才那样……那么容易分心的话。

lines.en: : You’ve been doing this for, like...one hour. Nobody’s perfect immediately.
lines.zh: : 你才练了，大概……一个小时。没人能一上来就完美。

lines.en: : I usually {i}am,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过我通常都{i}是{/i}。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo18
: And I...I’m not trying to brag! It’s just...soccer and...softball and...swimming...they’ve all been easy.
lines.zh: : 而且我……我不是在炫耀！只是……足球、……垒球、……游泳……那些对我来说都很轻松。

lines.en: : My parents say I’m just naturally gifted and stuff, but...what if that gift doesn’t extend to this? Then what?
lines.zh: : 我爸妈说我就是天生有天赋什么的，但……万一这天赋延伸不到这个上面呢？那怎么办？

lines.en: : Again, it’s been like one hour.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，你才练了大概一个小时。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo19
: {i}Hah...{/i}yeah.
: I’m getting into my head way too often lately. And it’s definitely not helping now that you’re here.
lines.zh: : 最近我老是钻牛角尖。而现在你在这儿，绝对只会让情况更糟。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Karin. If I knew you were going to be here-
lines.zh: : 对不起，Karin。如果我知道你会在这儿——

lines.en: : Just...save it, Sensei. We already talked about this. I just want to forget it ever happened and move on with my life.
lines.zh: : 省省吧，Sensei。这事我们已经说过了。我只想当它从没发生过，然后继续过我的日子。

lines.en: : Well...
: I can’t believe I’m saying this...but have you considered that talking about it might actually help? Not...with me, of course. Because that happened and clearly {i}didn’t{/i} help?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己会这么说……但你有没有想过，说出来其实可能有帮助？当然……不是跟我说。因为那次已经说过了，显然{i}没什么用{/i}？

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo20
: I have. But I have a few friends who would be really sad if you were suddenly in jail, and I don’t want to do that to them.
lines.zh: : 我想过。但我有几个朋友，如果你突然进了监狱，她们会很难过，我不想那样对她们。

lines.en: : I don’t mean talking to the police either. I mean talking to your sister.
lines.zh: : 我也不是让你跟警察说。我是说跟你妹妹说。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo21
: Kirin? No way. I don’t want to drag her into this.
lines.zh: : Kirin？不可能。我不想把她卷进来。

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
: Besides...aren’t you two, like...already...{i}involved{/i} in some way?
lines.zh: : 再说了……你们俩不是……已经……{i}有点什么{/i}了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I figure that would be a reason for you {i}to{/i} talk to her about it since you’d want to...protect her from me or whatever.
lines.zh: : 是，但我觉得这反而是你{i}该{/i}跟她谈的理由，因为你会想……保护她不受我伤害之类的。

lines.en: : I think this is actually one area where...Kirin knows more than I do. So protecting her, if anything, would be more like...stepping on her toes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在这一块上……Kirin 懂的其实比我多。所以保护她，要说有什么用的话，倒更像是……踩了她的脚。

lines.en: : I liked you too, Sensei. {i}Before{/i} all of this, obviously. So it’s not like I can tell her to just {i}stop{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢过你，Sensei。当然，是这一切发生{i}之前{/i}。所以我总不能叫她{i}别{/i}喜欢了。

lines.en: : If anything, she might even get mad at me for being that close to you when {i}she{/i} liked you first.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么的话，她甚至可能会生我的气——明明是{i}她{/i}先喜欢你的，我却跟你走得那么近。

lines.en: else:
: She’s got...enough going on in her own life. The last thing she needs is to be bogged down by having to deal with my problems too.
lines.zh: : 她自己的事……已经够多了。她最不需要的，就是还要被我的问题拖累。

lines.en: : B...Besides, knowing her she’d...probably just make fun of me for not going along with it or something.
lines.zh: : 再……再说，以她的性格……大概只会嘲笑我，说我当时顺着你不就得了之类的。

lines.en: : So, annoyingly, you’re kind of the only person I {i}can{/i} talk to about this without any immediate consequences. And that really, really sucks.
lines.zh: : 所以烦人的是，你差不多成了我唯一一个{i}能{/i}谈这事、又不会立刻带来后果的人。而这真的、真的糟透了。

lines.en: : I mean, I see where you’re coming from and all, but I wouldn’t be bringing this up if {i}she{/i} didn’t already come to me about it.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我明白你的想法，不过如果{i}她{/i}没有先来找过我，我也不会提这事。

lines.en: : She...wait, what? What happened?
lines.zh: : 她……等等，什么？发生什么了？

lines.en: : She and I made plans to hang out the other day but, once I got there, she dragged me all the way to the karaoke shop and then grilled me about what I did to you.
lines.zh: : 前几天我和她约好一起玩，结果我一到，她就把我一路拽到卡拉 OK 店，然后审问我对你做了什么。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo22
: {i}Kirin...{/i}did that?
lines.zh: : {i}Kirin……{/i}干的？

lines.en: : My sister, Kirin? or a different Kirin? Probably a different Kirin, right? Because my sister wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 我妹妹 Kirin？还是另一个 Kirin？大概是另一个 Kirin 吧？因为我妹妹不会——

lines.en: : She sure would. And she did. And to be honest, I’ve rarely ever seen her get that serious before.
lines.zh: : 她当然会。而且她确实做了。说实话，我很少见她那么认真过。

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo23
: But...Kirin shouldn’t even know about that? I didn’t tell her anything.
lines.zh: : 可是……Kirin 根本不该知道那件事啊？我什么都没跟她说。

lines.en: : Something Miku said must have tipped her off. Either way, your sister knows what happened now. And sorry if that...messes with your plan of trying to hide it from her or anything.
lines.zh: : 一定是 Miku 说了什么让她察觉了。不管怎样，你妹妹现在知道发生什么了。如果这打乱了你打算瞒着她的计划什么的，那抱歉。

lines.en: : I just felt like she deserved to know and...I didn’t want her worrying that things were worse than they actually were. Which was {i}still{/i} bad, but...you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得她有权知道，而且……我不想让她担心事情比实际更糟。虽然实际也已经{i}够糟{/i}了，但……你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Wonderful. So now my sister knows her crush tried to get with me in a private room. I’m sure that won’t have any effect on her inferiority complex at all.
lines.zh: : 好极了。现在我妹妹知道，她暗恋的对象想在包间里跟我搞上。这对她的自卑情结肯定一点影响都没有。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...again.
lines.zh: : 对不起……又一次。

lines.en: : I’ve been really striking out a lot with you lately, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 我最近在你这儿真是屡屡搞砸，对吧？

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo24
: You sure have. I’m starting to feel like Roki Sasaki.
lines.zh: : 你确实。我都开始觉得自己是 Roki Sasaki 了。

lines.en: : I have no idea who that is.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是谁。

lines.en: : Just...some baseball player.
lines.zh: : 就是……某个棒球运动员。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Why did you have to ruin everything, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要把一切都毁了，Sensei？

lines.en: scene karinatthedojo25
: I really liked spending time with you. Now I’m just...tense.
lines.zh: : 我以前真的很喜欢跟你待在一起。现在我只是……绷得紧紧的。

lines.en: : It was an accident, Karin.
lines.zh: : 那是意外，Karin。

lines.en: : I really didn’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我真的不想那样。

lines.en: : God, I...
lines.zh: : 天啊，我……

lines.en: scene black
: I just...really wish I could believe that.
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的希望我能相信。

lines.en: Karin gets up from the mat as Osako gathers the rest of the girls up and arranges them into a circle.
lines.zh: Osako 把其他女孩集合起来围成一圈，Karin 则从垫子上站了起来。

lines.en: Wanting a refresher on some of the basics (or just wanting to learn them for the first time), I stand in the background and wait for her lecture to come to an end.
lines.zh: 想复习一下基本功（或者干脆是第一次学），我站在后面等她讲完。

lines.en: I could move closer, I’m sure. I just have the lowest chance of hurting anyone back here.
lines.zh: 我确信我可以站得更近。只是待在这儿，伤到任何人的概率最低。

lines.en: Regardless, Karin gathers her things, bows to Osako, then leaves with the rest of the crowd a few minutes later.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Karin 收拾好东西，向 Osako 鞠了一躬，几分钟后随其他人一起离开了。

lines.en: But she never says goodbye to me — and I can’t blame her for that.
lines.zh: 但她始终没有跟我道别——而这也怪不得她。
